stops.note: 'to know, know how to', the ancestor of modern 'can'
'learned, skilful'; Psalm 137 in the 1611 Bible says 'let my right hand forget her cunning', meaning her skill
darkened to 'crafty, sly', though village healers were still called 'cunning folk' into the 1800s
